runs.summary: Data through Oct 30 (Q4 22-day partial). Top 3: XLE +59.7%, SMH +45.1%, CIBR +41.8%. SPY P/E: 23.88x
runs.content:
Top 5 YTD 2026: XLE +59.7% (P/E 16.42x, Fair), SMH +45.1% (28.29x, Elevated), CIBR +41.8% (35.09x, Expensive), XBI +28.1% (22.99x*, Fair, profitable holdings only), XLK +25.1% (30.43x, Elevated).

Bottom 5 YTD 2026: XLC -14.4% (14.64x, Cheap), GLD -10.2% (P/E N/A), GDX -10.1% (12.12x, Cheap), ICLN -6.6% (20.12x, Fair), XME -5.4% (16.11x, Fair).

Notable shifts: CIBR gave back last week's bounce (~-4.8%; Q4 +2.9% -> -2.0%), fell back to #3 behind SMH, and moved Continuing -> Consolidating. Its P/E (35.09x) is only just Expensive. XLC fell another ~5.4% and crossed Fair -> Cheap (the only band crossing). XLP Fading -> Breakout (Q4 +10.9%, its best 2026 quarter). XLV Continuing -> Accelerating (Q4 +9.8%). Gold kept sliding (GDX -3.8%, GLD -3.0% on the week; both ~-10% YTD). ITA flipped positive for Q4 (+1.2%) and de-rated to 28.74x. ICLN's P/E rose again on a falling price (recheck). SPY is +11.7% YTD (Q4 -0.9%); 10 of 25 sectors beat it; 8 are negative YTD.
